scripts.tf:init: cd terraform && echo "terraform: env=${ENV_NAME:-dev} workspace=${ENV_NAME:-dev} profile=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev}" && AWS_PROFILE=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev} terraform init -input=false -backend-config=../../terraform/environments/${ENV_NAME:-dev}/backend.hcl && AWS_PROFILE=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev} terraform workspace select -or-create ${ENV_NAME:-dev}
scripts.tf:reconfigure: cd terraform && AWS_PROFILE=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev} terraform init -reconfigure -input=false -backend-config=../../terraform/environments/${ENV_NAME:-dev}/backend.hcl && AWS_PROFILE=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev} terraform workspace select -or-create ${ENV_NAME:-dev}
scripts.tf:plan: cd terraform && echo "terraform: env=${ENV_NAME:-dev} workspace=${ENV_NAME:-dev} profile=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev}" && AWS_PROFILE=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev} terraform plan -input=false -out=tfplan -var-file=../../terraform/environments/${ENV_NAME:-dev}/main.tfvars
scripts.tf:apply: cd terraform && echo "terraform: env=${ENV_NAME:-dev} workspace=${ENV_NAME:-dev} profile=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev}" && AWS_PROFILE=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev} terraform apply -input=false tfplan
scripts.tf:destroy: cd terraform && echo "terraform: env=${ENV_NAME:-dev} workspace=${ENV_NAME:-dev} profile=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev}" && AWS_PROFILE=${AWS_PROFILE:-basilmariano-dev} terraform destroy -var-file=../../terraform/environments/${ENV_NAME:-dev}/main.tfvars
